Name: Warp
Description: The size of the warp noise. Controls the scale of the distortion pattern applied to the input.

Name: Size
Description: The size of the warp noise. Controls the scale of the distortion pattern applied to the input.

Name: Strength
Description: The strength of the warp noise. Higher values produce more pronounced distortions.

Name: Z Scale
Description: Vertical axis scale for the noise, affecting the intensity of the warp along the Z (height) axis.

Name: Warp Source
Description: Selects the noise or pattern used as the source for the warp. Choose from built-in options or provide a custom source.

Flubs.Name: PerlinFBM
Flubs.Description: Uses Perlin fractal Brownian motion noise as the warp source, producing smooth, natural distortions.

Flubs.Name: VoronoiR
Flubs.Description: Uses Voronoi (R) noise as the warp source, creating cell-like, ridged distortions.

Flubs.Name: VoronoiP
Flubs.Description: Uses Voronoi (P) noise as the warp source, suitable for generating mountainous or peak-like distortions.

Flubs.Name: VoronoiA
Flubs.Description: Uses Voronoi (A) noise as the warp source, blending characteristics of other Voronoi types for varied effects.

Flubs.Name: VoronoiS
Flubs.Description: Uses Voronoi (S) noise as the warp source, emphasizing separated, individual cell boundaries.

Flubs.Name: VoronoiM
Flubs.Description: Uses Voronoi (M) noise as the warp source, favoring dominant cells for strong, directional warping.

Flubs.Name: VoronoiD
Flubs.Description: Uses Voronoi (D) noise as the warp source, emphasizing ridges and linear features in the distortion.

Name: Perturbation
Description: Applies additional random displacement to the warp, increasing the irregularity and complexity of the effect.

Name: Complexity
Description: The complexity of the warp noise source. Higher values add more detail and layers to the distortion.

Name: Roughness
Description: The roughness of the warp noise. Higher values (especially above 0.5) create harsher, more jagged distortions.

Name: Normalized
Description: Specifies whether the noise is normalized. Normalization ensures the output remains within a standard range.

Name: Edge Behaviour
Description: Determines how the warp handles the edges of the input, preventing visible seams or artifacts.

Flubs.Name: Edge
Flubs.Description: Applies standard edge handling, which may result in wrapping or stretching at the borders.

Flubs.Name: Mirror
Flubs.Description: Edge pixels are mirrored, creating seamless, reflected borders for the warp effect.

Name: Modulation
Description: The amount of modulation to use from the Modulation input (if connected), allowing external control over the warp intensity.

Name: Modulation Direction
Description: Sets the direction of the modulation, controlling how the modulation input influences the warp.

Name: Seed
Description: The randomization pattern or seed for the node's process. Changing the seed produces different warp results.

Name: Iterative
Description: Number of warp iterations to apply. More iterations increase the complexity and layering of the distortion.

Name: Iterations
Description: Number of warp iterations to apply. More iterations increase the complexity and layering of the distortion.

Name: Mode
Description: Specifies the mode used for iterative warping, affecting how each pass is calculated and applied.

Flubs.Name: Bitmap
Flubs.Description: Applies the warp using standard bitmap-based processing for each iteration.

Flubs.Name: VectorField
Flubs.Description: Uses a vector field to guide the warp, allowing for more directional and flow-based distortions.

Flubs.Name: VectorFieldIntegral
Flubs.Description: Integrates the vector field over multiple passes, producing complex, cumulative warp effects.
